note: 銃声 is the sound of a gunshot; the English definition also includes an explosion, so this Japanese term covers only part of the bundled sense.
ラン is a broad loanword and is only natural for an animal enclosure or track in compounds; the English definition bundles two usages without one matching Japanese lemma.
大義 fits a morally elevated cause or principle that goes beyond self-interest, as specified by the English definition.
デー is the conventional day element in named observances and fits the holiday or annual observance sense, though it commonly appears in compounds.
Bare プレイ means play or recreation generally. The phrase 性的なプレイ narrows it to the sexual activity or role-playing sense; its base noun is JMdict ent_seq 1116400 sense 0.
音符 is the musical-note symbol; âm phù is a valid formal Vietnamese term for a musical note, though nốt nhạc is more common in everyday use.
処刑 denotes execution. Vietnamese tử hình commonly refers to the death sentence or penalty, while hành quyết names the act of carrying it out.
法人 means an incorporated or juridical person and excludes natural individuals, while the English legal sense expressly includes both.
The Vietnamese củ is a broad everyday term for underground plant organs. Thân củ specifies the fleshy underground stem described by the English definition.
追放 covers exile, banishment, and deportation, which are all included in this English definition; sự trục xuất is a direct Vietnamese equivalent.
Bare phím can mean a keyboard or piano key. Phím đàn identifies the raised fret on a string instrument in this definition.
唸る directly includes the deep growl of an angry animal; its other extended uses do not conflict with the stated context.
Tiết lộ means disclose generally. Rò rỉ is the usual verb for information escaping surreptitiously, especially in the phrase rò rỉ thông tin.
結節 is a technical node or nodule, but the English entry also covers a general knob, protuberance, or swelling; this Japanese term does not cover the full listed range.
JMdict reverse lookup gives 脅かす as to startle, frighten, and scare (ent_seq 1578070 sense 1); the threat verb is 脅す, a different form.
窯 and lò can both denote a heated kiln or furnace chamber. The English definition itself includes an oven or furnace, so the terms fit its stated breadth.
ホームページ is often used in Japanese for an entire website. トップページ specifically means a website home page in JMdict (ent_seq 2779370 sense 0).
統治 means rule or governing, and sự trị vì directly expresses the exercise of sovereign power.
インテリ can refer to one intellectual. 知識階級 means intellectual or educated class and is glossed as intelligentsia in JMdict (ent_seq 1800360 sense 0).
甥 is the direct Japanese equivalent, and cháu trai is the standard Vietnamese kinship term for a nephew; the supplied relation definition distinguishes it from other uses such as grandson.
Thực vật means plants generally; thảm thực vật is the Vietnamese collective term for vegetation or plant cover.
Khoa mắt commonly means an eye department or clinic. Nhãn khoa names the medical field of ophthalmology.
Mụn is a broad word for skin blemishes. Mụn mủ specifies a raised spot containing pus, matching the defining feature in this English sense.
Cồn can refer to alcohol generally. Etanol is the Vietnamese chemical name for the specific compound CH₃-CH₂-OH.
意地 can include positive willpower or pride. 頑固 means stubbornness or obstinacy and is a noun/adjectival noun in JMdict (ent_seq 1217680 sense 0).
Đồ thêu means embroidered goods. Nghệ thuật thêu expresses the art or process of ornamenting fabric with needlework.
名高い tends to imply positive renown. 有名 is the neutral famous or well-known adjectival noun in JMdict (ent_seq 1541620 sense 0).
角 also means a horn generally. 枝角 specifically means an antler in JMdict (ent_seq 2060180 sense 0).
作り方 and công thức are both standard, natural equivalents for instructions for preparing a food dish.
Đồng alone can mean the metal, currency unit, or a coin generally. Đồng xu bằng đồng explicitly identifies a coin made of copper.
消す has other meanings, but its fire-extinguishing sense directly matches extinguish; dập tắt is a natural Vietnamese equivalent.
桟橋 is the Japanese term for a pier structure; the seaside entertainment use in the English definition is a particular use of that structure.
Ống vòi is understandable but awkward. Ống mềm is the natural Vietnamese term for a flexible hose or tube.

revision.vi: vỏ của động vật thân mềm biển

note: Vỏ sò is often used colloquially for seashells but literally suggests a bivalve shell. This descriptive Vietnamese phrase covers the empty shell of any marine mollusk.
Tượng đài commonly refers to a statue monument. Công trình kỷ niệm covers a broader commemorative structure without requiring a statue.
Phù thủy often suggests a witch. Pháp sư is a more neutral Vietnamese word for a sorcerer, magician, or wizard.
相対 can be ambiguous as the bare form. 相対性 directly names relativity in JMdict (ent_seq 1748970 sense 0).
お大事に is reserved for someone who is ill. 気をつけて is a common general parting wish to take care; its JMdict base form 気をつける is ent_seq 1591990 sense 0.
避難 and sự ẩn náu denote taking refuge or hiding, an action; the English definition describes the state of safety, protection, or shelter.
ロータス is understood as lotus but is a loanword; 蓮 is the ordinary Japanese plant name and JMdict glosses it as sacred or Indian lotus (ent_seq 1559200 sense 0).
